title: Three Winters and One Short Crate
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：glass　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 glass 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 the sorter ① sorted the glass that no volunteer in the depot would have described, and he said the sorting was the whole of the winter. The ② glass, meaning the material itself and not the bottle, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; glass, he said, is the only thing in a depot that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ kind of glass in that depot had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ glass at the far shelf, meaning the panes they kept for the children's greenhouse and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Glass, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the sorter said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the glass was the whole of the matter, meaning the mirror and not the material. The ⑥ glass, meaning the mirror and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; glass, he said, is either something you sort or the only word that means both a material and a mirror. He said the mirror is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ glass had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ glass of the whole thing, the sorter wrote in November, was one depot and three winters of describing; glass, he said, is either the panes at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ glass I remember is the glass described in the list, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the depot. ⑩ Glass, my mother said in 1983, is the only material that improves by being described; all glass, she said, is a mirror that has agreed to look like a material. She said the mirror was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 玻璃；玻璃制品（指回收站里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 玻璃；玻璃材料（指那种材料本身，与瓶子相对）
C. 固定搭配：sort the glass 分拣玻璃
D. n. 玻璃（指留给孩子们温室用的那些窗玻璃）
E. n. 玻璃（抽象总称，指一处回收站的玻璃之事）
F. n. 玻璃（指清单里写到、被称过的那些）
G. n. 镜子；玻璃杯（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 镜面（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sorted the glass that no volunteer in the depot would have described
The glass, meaning the material itself and not the bottle
Every kind of glass in that depot
the glass at the far shelf
the glass was the whole of the matter
the glass had become a line in a list
The glass of the whole thing

answers.why: sort the glass 意为“分拣玻璃”，1974 年那位分拣工分拣了回收站里没有一位志愿者肯描述的玻璃。
glass 意为“玻璃、玻璃材料”，指那种材料本身而不是瓶子，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
glass 意为“玻璃、玻璃制品”，指回收站里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只矮矮的板条箱。
glass 意为“玻璃”，指最远那层架上留给孩子们温室用的那些窗玻璃，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
glass 意为“镜子、玻璃杯”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这面镜子就是那件事的全部。
glass 意为“镜面”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那些玻璃，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
glass 意为“玻璃”，指清单里写到、被称过的那些，到 1979 年这些成了清单里的一行。
glass 意为“玻璃”，分拣工十一月写道，整件事的玻璃之事是一处回收站和三个冬天的描述。
glass 意为“玻璃”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那些，1981 年清运完了，至今仍被说成回收站里最安静的一批。
glass 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，玻璃是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的材料。
